ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (FIN11 / GRACEFUL SPIDER) LEMURLOOT webshell drop (human2.aspx) on MOVEit Transfer
ucs.description: Hunts the deployment of the LEMURLOOT ASP.NET webshell — file name human2.aspx — in the MOVEit Transfer wwwroot directory. This is the signature post-exploitation artefact of Cl0p's 2023 mass exploitation of CVE-2023-34362 (Mandiant cluster UNC4857, Microsoft 'Lace Tempest' / Spandex Tempest). The webshell name is hard-coded by the actor and is not seen in legitimate MOVEit deployments.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true allow_old_summaries=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem WHERE (Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*" Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx") OR (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot\\*" Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx")) BY Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=left process_guid [ | tstats summariesonly=true count FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes BY Processes.process_guid Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` ] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user file_path file_name process_name parent_process_name process
ucs.kql:
let LookBack = 30d;
let WebshellDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookBack)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FileName =~ "human2.aspx"
       or (FileName endswith ".aspx"
           and FolderPath has_any (@"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot", @"\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot")
           and InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256, FileSize,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
let AppPoolShellSpawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookBack)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MoveitTransfer","MOVEitTransfer","MOVEit Transfer")
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
WebshellDrops
| union AppPoolShellSpawns
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookBack = 30d;
let FileSide = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookBack)
    | where EventType =~ "FileCreated" or EventType =~ "FileModified" or EventType =~ "FileRenamed"
    | where TargetFileName =~ "human2.aspx"
       or (TargetFileExtension =~ "aspx" and TargetFilePath has_any (@"MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot", @"MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot"))
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName,
              TargetFileSHA256, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
let UrlSide = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookBack)
    | where csUriStem =~ "/human2.aspx" or csUriStem endswith "/human2.aspx"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, csMethod, csUriStem, csUriQuery,
              cIP, csUserAgent, scStatus, csUserName;
FileSide
| extend Source = "FileEvent"
| union (UrlSide | extend Source = "IIS")
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT Webshell (human2.aspx) Written to MOVEit Transfer wwwroot
id: 6f43c6d2-c9d4-4f6f-9c3a-1c0a9d0f7b40
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the creation of the LEMURLOOT webshell (human2.aspx) on a MOVEit
  Transfer server, a unique post-exploitation signature of the Cl0p / FIN11
  mass-exploitation campaign against CVE-2023-34362 (UNC4857 / Lace Tempest).
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\human2.aspx'
  selection_moveit_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\'
  condition: selection_filename or selection_moveit_path
falsepositives:
  - Highly unlikely; the file name is not used by any legitimate MOVEit feature
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\human2.aspx OR *\\Human2.aspx OR *\\HUMAN2.ASPX OR *\\human2.ASPX) OR (@TargetFilename:(*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx OR *\\MOVEit?Transfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx OR *\\moveittransfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx) AND @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/human2\.aspx$/i OR (TargetFileName=/\.aspx$/i AND regex("MOVEit[ ]?Transfer\\\\wwwroot", field=TargetFileName, strict=false))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId], function={ min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | count(as=writes) })
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: human2.aspx is the static, hard-coded LEMURLOOT artefact unique to Cl0p's MOVEit campaign (Mandiant UNC4857, Microsoft Lace Tempest / Spandex Tempest, CrowdStrike GRACEFUL SPIDER). No legitimate MOVEit installation ships or generates this file. Pairing the file-create signal with w3wp.exe (MoveitTransfer app pool) spawning cmd/powershell catches the same actor's xp_cmdshell-driven hands-on-keyboar

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p Cleo MFT autorun abuse — Cleo Harmony/VLTrader/LexiCom Java spawning shell interpreter (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956)
ucs.description: Hunts the post-exploitation child-process pattern from Cl0p's December 2024 mass exploitation of Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom MFT servers, where a malicious archive placed in the autorun directory caused the Cleo Java process to launch PowerShell/cmd and stage the Malichus / TrueBot loader. The combination of a Cleo MFT parent path and a scripting-engine child is highly specific tradecraft for this actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true allow_old_summaries=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.parent_process_name IN ("javaw.exe","java.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(parent_process, "(?i)Cleo[ _-]?(Harmony|VLTrader|LexiCom)|cleo\.jar|\\\\Cleo[ ]?(Harmony|VLTrader|LexiCom)\\\\") | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name parent_process process_name process
ucs.kql:
let LookBack = 30d;
let CleoPaths = dynamic([@"\Cleo Harmony\", @"\Cleo VLTrader\", @"\Cleo LexiCom\"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookBack)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("javaw.exe","java.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (CleoPaths)
     or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (CleoPaths)
     or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("cleo.jar","VLTrader","LexiCom","Cleo Harmony")
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256,
          IsRemote = InitiatingProcessTokenElevation
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookBack = 30d;
let CleoMarkers = dynamic([@"\Cleo Harmony\", @"\Cleo VLTrader\", @"\Cleo LexiCom\", "cleo.jar", "VLTrader", "LexiCom"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookBack)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("javaw.exe","java.exe")
| where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (CleoMarkers)
| where TargetProcessName has_any (SuspiciousChildren)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, Hash
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p Cleo MFT (Harmony/VLTrader/LexiCom) Java Spawning Shell Interpreter
id: 8c2e2c0d-1f9c-4b7a-9c0d-3d2b9a4f1c20
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects a Cleo MFT Java process (javaw.exe / java.exe running from a
  Cleo Harmony / VLTrader / LexiCom installation directory) spawning a
  scripting or LOLBin child, matching the Cl0p post-exploitation chain
  for CVE-2024-50623 and CVE-2024-55956.
references:
  - https://www.huntress.com/blog/cleo-software-actively-being-exploited-in-the-wild
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/cl0p-cleo-exploitation
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_java:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\java.exe'
  parent_cleo:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - '\Cleo Harmony\'
      - '\Cleo VLTrader\'
      - '\Cleo LexiCom\'
      - 'cleo.jar'
      - 'VLTrader'
      - 'LexiCom'
  child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
  condition: parent_java and parent_cleo and child_shell
falsepositives:
  - Cleo administrators running manual diagnostic scripts (rare; verify with Cleo owner)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\javaw.exe OR *\\java.exe OR *\\Javaw.exe OR *\\Java.exe OR *\\JAVAW.EXE OR *\\JAVA.EXE) (@ParentCommandLine:(*\\Cleo?Harmony\\* OR *\\Cleo?VLTrader\\* OR *\\Cleo?LexiCom\\* OR *cleo.jar* OR *VLTrader* OR *LexiCom*)) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\certutil.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentImageFileName=/\\(javaw?|java)\.exe$/i
| regex("Cleo[ _-]?(Harmony|VLTrader|LexiCom)|cleo\\.jar|VLTrader|LexiCom", field=ParentCommandLine, strict=false)
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|bitsadmin|certutil)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function={ min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | count(as=spawns) })
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Cl0p (TA505 / FIN11 / GRACEFUL SPIDER) chained the December 2024 Cleo autorun-directory bug (CVE-2024-50623 / CVE-2024-55956) to drop the Malichus PowerShell loader, then TrueBot, then the Cl0p encryptor. The Cleo Harmony/VLTrader/LexiCom Java process tree is narrow — these products are not consumer software — and a Java parent running from a Cleo install path spawning powershell/cmd/mshta is esse
